title: fix(plugin-auth): register an MCP client that omits application_type with a loopback or custom-scheme redirect as native
body:
Fixes #25118

Clause-②: no (a runtime security-boundary change the maintainer ruled; no published type, export or metadata key moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

plugin-auth now passes `clientRegistrationDefaultApplicationType: 'infer'` to `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.12. A comment names this card, ruling `6329352251` (letter A1) and the measured boundary. The whole production change is that one option line in the `oauthProvider({ ... })` options of `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`. There is no hook on `/oauth2/register` and no second classification rule (ruling A1, items 1 and 4).

- **Before:** a dynamic registration that omitted `application_type` was filled as `web`. The web redirect rule refuses a loopback `http` or custom-scheme redirect, so every local MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex CLI) was refused at registration with `invalid_redirect_uri`.
- **After:** the provider's own classifier treats such a body as `native` when any redirect URI uses a non-http(s) scheme or `http` on exactly `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` or `[::1]`, and it then holds each redirect to the native rule. Every other body stays `web`. An `application_type` the client sends is never overridden.
- **Scope:** the classifier runs only on the dynamic registration source (`registerEndpoint` in the installed dist). The Setup form's managed `create-client` door (`/sys-oauth-application/register`) is not affected. The option does nothing while DCR is off.
- **No layer in front:** plugin-auth puts nothing in front of `/oauth2/register`. The global before-hook has no branch for that path, and `auth-plugin.ts` mounts no raw route on it.

## The measured boundary, pinned on the real provider

The new file `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.mcp-oauth-dcr-infer.test.ts` boots the real better-auth 1.7.12 and `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.12 handler from the exact options `AuthManager` produces (MCP on, so DCR on), then drives `POST /oauth2/register` and `GET /oauth2/authorize`.

Every body omits `application_type`, as the clients send it. The first cell sends the card's own reproduction body and asserts that it has no `application_type` key. The existing `auth-manager.mcp-oauth-resource.test.ts` registers with `application_type: native` spelled out, which is why it stayed green through this defect.

| Cell (no `application_type` unless stated) | Registration | Authorize |
|---|---|---|
| The card's body: public client, `http://localhost` redirect | 201 `native`, no secret | refused without PKCE, consent with PKCE |
| Public, `http://127.0.0.1` redirect | 201 `native` | refused without PKCE, consent with PKCE |
| Public, custom-scheme (`cursor://`) redirect | 201 `native` | refused without PKCE, consent with PKCE |
| Public, `https://evil.example/cb` alone | 201 `web` (unchanged) | refused without PKCE, consent with PKCE |
| Public, `http://evil.example/cb` | 400 `invalid_redirect_uri`, no client stored | n/a |
| Public, `http://localhost.evil.example/cb` | 400 `invalid_redirect_uri`, no client stored | n/a |
| Public, loopback, explicit `application_type: web` | 400 `invalid_redirect_uri` (a sent type is never overridden) | n/a |
| Confidential (`client_secret_basic`), loopback | 201 `native`, **issued a `client_secret`** | refused without PKCE, consent with PKCE |
| Auth method omitted (filled as `client_secret_basic`), loopback | 201 `native`, **issued a `client_secret`** | refused without PKCE, consent with PKCE |
| Confidential (`client_secret_basic`), custom scheme | 201 `native`, **issued a `client_secret`** | refused without PKCE, consent with PKCE |
| Public, loopback plus `https://evil.example/cb` in one body | 201 `native` (any qualifying redirect classifies the body) | refused without PKCE, consent with PKCE |
| DCR off (`OS_OIDC_DCR_ENABLED=false`), the card's body | 403 `access_denied`, no client stored | n/a |

- **Not "public clients only".** The confidential rows are stated as they behave. The classifier reads redirect URIs and never `token_endpoint_auth_method`. The same confidential body with `application_type: native` spelled out is already accepted on `main`, so no registrable client shape is added; only the meaning of an omitted field changes (ruling A1, item 3).
- **PKCE.** PKCE stays required at authorize for every registered client: always for a public client, and for a confidential DCR client because `clientRegistrationRequirePKCE` keeps its `true` default.
- **The PKCE check is a differential.** "Refused without PKCE" means a redirect back to the client's own redirect URI with `error=invalid_request`, a description that names PKCE, and no code. The paired request is identical apart from the S256 PKCE parameters (same client, session, redirect, scopes and resource) and reaches the consent page, so the refusal cannot have another cause.
- **Liveness.** The existing test "every option AuthManager passes occurs in the installed provider" (`auth-manager.mcp-oauth-resource.test.ts`) now also covers the new option name.

## Verification

The package readings below were taken at `5a7e1f02a`, on the shared container. The head `6d4fd2a5a` is that commit merged with `origin/main` `9cfc57533`. The four incoming commits touch `cloud-connection`, `runtime`, `service-automation`, `verify`, docs and an ADR, and none of those is in plugin-auth's dependency closure. So the package readings stand (the scoped re-check of AGENTS §10), and the gate union was re-run on `6d4fd2a5a`. The test imports `./auth-manager` from source, so the ablation needed no rebuild to reach the run.

- **New file:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/auth-manager.mcp-oauth-dcr-infer.test.ts` gave `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 12 passed (12)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Ablation (one-time, not committed):** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the option line. Proof that it landed: anchor count 1 then 0, blob `9c00cadb` then `a4a53154`. Result: `Tests 7 failed | 5 passed (12)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 1`.
  - Red, as predicted: all seven native cells (the card's body, `127.0.0.1`, custom scheme, the three confidential cells, the mixed body). Each got `400 invalid_redirect_uri: web clients require https redirect URIs on non-loopback hosts`, the production symptom.
  - Green, as predicted: the five cells that do not depend on the option (`https` alone stays `web`; the two foreign `http` hosts and explicit `web` stay refused; DCR off is 403).
  - Restore proven: blob equals HEAD `9c00cadb`, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty.
- **Package suite:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` gave `Test Files 182 passed (182)`, `Tests 3450 passed | 10 skipped (3460)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` exited 0. That covers the source, the examples, and the test layer under `tsconfig.test.json` (debt ledger held, no growth).
- **Build and published surface:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth build` exited 0. The built `dist/*.d.ts` has 0 hits for `clientRegistrationDefaultApplicationType`, while `dist/index.mjs` has 1 (positive control), so no published type moves.
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 70 commands at `6d4fd2a5a` (merge base `9cfc57533`). All 70 ran and exited 0, with each code captured before any pipe. The `--ran` reconciliation reads "70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". The rest of the farm and the type-check lanes run in CI.

## Acceptance owed after this lands

Ruling `6329352251` item 5 (carried from `6327761812`) requires a browser walk on a deployed environment after the cloud pin moves: `claude mcp add --transport http NAME https://ENV-HOST/api/v1/mcp`, then `/mcp`, then Authenticate, completing in the browser and listing the tools. That walk makes the environment's Setup, Integrations, Connect an Agent page true. **Not measured here:** it needs a deployed environment.

## Acceptance notes

- The comment above `rawApp.post(... /sys-oauth-application/register ...)` in `auth-plugin.ts` still says DCR on `/oauth2/register` is something "we don't want to enable broadly". DCR has been on by default whenever the MCP server is on (`resolveDcrEnabled`), so that sentence is stale. It is noted only: it is outside this card's file surface and changes no behaviour.
- The `describe` titles in `auth-manager.mcp-oauth-resource.test.ts` still say "installed 1.7.2" while the installed provider is 1.7.12. This is naming only, noted and not changed.
